behaviors.description: Control accessibility socket exposure and actual bus-name ownership through a private provider.
behaviors.preconditions: Independent installed probe and separately compiled org.a11y.Bus provider returning a case-private bus.
behaviors.expected: Explicit enable after disable exposes a real accessibility socket; later disable removes it. Ownership fails without a grant and acquires PRIMARY_OWNER with the exact a11y-own-name grant.

mappings.rationale: Real socket visibility and RequestName outcomes establish accessibility isolation, without any host accessibility bus.

surface_assertions.rationale: An explicit grant after disabling restores the actual sandbox accessibility socket.
Revocation after enabling removes the real socket from the sandbox.
The otherwise-denied name is actually acquired on the controlled accessibility bus.
